cards.name: Bring to Trial
cards.oracleText: Exile target creature with power 4 or greater.

cards.name: Bring Low
cards.oracleText: Bring Low deals 3 damage to target creature. If that creature has a +1/+1 counter on it, Bring Low deals 5 damage to it instead.

cards.name: Carry Away
cards.oracleText:
Enchant Equipment
When this Aura enters, unattach enchanted Equipment.
You control enchanted Equipment.

cards.name: Eiganjo Uprising
cards.oracleText:
Create X 2/2 white Samurai creature tokens with vigilance. They gain menace and haste until end of turn.
Each opponent creates X minus one 2/2 white Samurai creature tokens with vigilance.

cards.name: Elemental Uprising
cards.oracleText: Target land you control becomes a 4/4 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn. It's still a land. It must be blocked this turn if able.

cards.name: Garruk's Uprising
cards.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
Creatures you control have trample. (Each of those creatures can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.

cards.name: Stensia Uprising
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 red Human creature token. Then if you control exactly thirteen permanents, you may sacrifice this enchantment. When you do, it deals 7 damage to any target.

cards.name: Take for a Ride
cards.oracleText:
Take for a Ride has flash as long as you've committed a crime this turn. (Targeting opponents, anything they control, and/or cards in their graveyards is a crime.)
Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn.

cards.name: Rising Populace
cards.oracleText: Whenever another creature or planeswalker you control dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Spirit Away
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
You control enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and has flying.

cards.name: Undercity Uprising
cards.oracleText: Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn. Then target creature you control fights target creature you don't control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)

cards.name: Shepherd of the Flock // Usher to Safety
cards.oracleText: Return target permanent you control to its owner's hand. (Then exile this card. You may cast the creature later from exile.)

cards.name: Take into Custody
cards.oracleText: Tap target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
